sources.title: Random Features for Large-Scale Kernel Machines
sources.supports: A frozen randomized feature map can preserve or approximate a declared similarity structure without learning its internal features.

sources.title: Neural Tangent Kernel: Convergence and Generalization in Neural Networks
sources.supports: Random initialization already induces measurable kernel structure; a blank neural canvas is not assumption-free.

sources.title: Echo state networks are universal
sources.supports: Reservoir systems provide established theory for fixed neural state maps with separate readouts.

claim_boundary: The local experiment validates a fixed response instrument and reports no target-estimation advantage. It does not claim a cryptographic break or a novel random-feature theory.
